purpose: Instantiate the separate Japanese Indian Ocean commerce-raiding operation without conflating it with the Oyodo Eastern-Fleet interception reserve.
branch_compatibility: Inherited because no posted Branch event removes or damages Tone, Chikuma, Aoba, Oi, Kinu, Uranami, Amagiri or Shikinami before this clock. Existing Bengal damage to Uranami/Shikinami had Jan-1944 repair clocks and does not block Feb departure.

chronology.event: Aoba attached to CruDiv 16 as Sakonjo flagship with Kinu; commerce-raiding formation preparation is treated as active.

Tone + Chikuma + Aoba depart Lingga; Oi + Kinu + Uranami + Amagiri + Shikinami provide the associated Singapore/Lingga escort movement toward Banka. Uranami is one hull and is not double-counted across source descriptions.
chronology.mission: SA No.1 commerce raiding; not an interception sortie against Illustrious.
chronology.global_effect: Force is committed to south/west movement and is unavailable for speculative Bay/Andaman interception while this mission is active.

separation_from_Oyodo_group.status_at_27T24: HELD Singapore/Lingga reserve for fresh RN contact/night exploitation
separation_from_Oyodo_group.reason: No SLEUTH weapon-quality contact and no need to burn the dedicated observation/interception reserve on routine escort.

air_ASW_interlock: Tokai/MAD western detachment provides bounded departure-lane risk reduction around Penang/Singapore/Sumatra; no submarine kill is credited. Ka-go local contribution remains zero.
next_gate: On 1 Mar, SA No.1 reaches Banka and then enters the Indian Ocean commerce-raiding phase; adjudicate Allied intelligence/submarine/air reaction before inheriting later results.
